def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_enables_only_the_email_destination_in_the_add_shortcut_screen(self):
        """
        Description: C63
        Steps:
            1.Install and Launch the HPX app.
            2.Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
            3.Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
            4.Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
            5.Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
            6.Enable only the 'Email' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.
            7.Then click on the Continue button.
            8.Verify the screen.
        Expected Result:
            User should be navigated to the 'Add Email' screen.
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_email_toggle_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_edit_shortcut_email_screen_title()

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Mapping Split Rule for Complex Preconditions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Preconditions that involve multiple distinct actions requiring 3+ script lines
rule_definition: WHEN: A precondition maps to 3 or more sequential script actions that serve different purposes
THEN: Split the precondition into sub-steps labeled with letters (1a, 1b, 1c, etc.)
IMPLEMENTATION: Create parent step with split_required=true, create child steps with parent_step reference, assign sequential execution_order, map each sub-step to one script line

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Screen Verification Rule for Navigation Actions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that perform navigation to new screens
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step performs navigation action (click, tap) that should load a new screen
THEN: Insert implicit verification step immediately after to confirm screen loaded
IMPLEMENTATION: Add step with 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' prefix, set implicit=true, required_for_execution=true, verification_type='screen_validation', parent_step reference

automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step requires multiple script lines THEN decompose into sub_steps with sub_step_id format '{step_number}{letter}' WHERE letter increments alphabetically (a,b,c...) AND each sub_step represents atomic action AND execution order must be preserved

automation_scripts_rules.description: Application Initialization Rule: App launch and setup steps must include reset and home screen loading as separate sub-steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves 'Install and Launch' OR 'Open application' THEN MUST include sub_step for reset_app() AND sub_step for flow_load_home_screen() AND reset must execute before home screen load

automation_scripts_rules.description: Navigation Flow Rule: Multi-screen navigation steps must be broken down into click action followed by verification sub-steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves navigating to new screen THEN decompose into sub_steps: click/action sub_step FOLLOWED BY verify screen title sub_step AND each navigation transition requires verification

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Identification Rule: Steps required for test execution but not explicitly stated in test case must be marked as 'Implicit Step' with purpose classification
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF step is required for automation execution BUT not explicit in manual test case THEN prefix with 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution:' AND include purpose explanation AND assign sub_step_id with 'I' prefix (I1a, I2a, etc.)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Supporting Step Rule: Verification steps that validate test case purpose must be identified as supporting steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF step contains multiple verification actions for test validation purpose THEN prefix with 'Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation:' AND assign sub_step_id with 'S' prefix (S1a, S1b, etc.) AND group related verifications together

automation_scripts_rules.description: Verification Step Pattern Rule: Verification actions must use verify_* method pattern and be placed after corresponding action
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF action requires validation THEN include verify_* method call as separate sub_step immediately after action sub_step AND verification sub_step_id must follow action sub_step_id sequentially

automation_scripts_rules.description: Form Input Prerequisite Rule: Form field dependencies must be satisfied before dependent field actions
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF form field B depends on field A being populated THEN create implicit step for field A population BEFORE explicit step for field B AND document dependency in implicit step description

automation_scripts_rules.description: Toggle/Switch Action Rule: Toggle or switch actions map to single click method with descriptive action name
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves enabling/disabling toggle or switch THEN map to single click_*_toggle_btn() method AND sub_step action must specify toggle state change

automation_scripts_rules.description: Button Click Action Rule: Button click actions must use descriptive click method names that identify the button
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves clicking button THEN use click_*_btn() method pattern WHERE * describes button purpose AND action description must include button name from UI

automation_scripts_rules.description: Search Action Rule: Search operations must include search method with parameter specification
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves searching THEN use search_* method with search criteria parameter AND parameter must reference test data source (self.p.* or hardcoded value)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Assertion Rule: Final verification steps must use assert statement for test case validation
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step is final behavior verification THEN prepend 'assert' to verification method call AND assertion must validate expected outcome of test case

automation_scripts_rules.description: Multi-Line Script Breakdown Rule: When mapped_script_line contains multiple lines separated by newline, each line becomes separate sub_step
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF mapped_script_line contains '\n' separator THEN split into individual sub_steps WHERE each line maps to one sub_step AND sub_step_id increments alphabetically AND preserve execution order

automation_scripts_rules.description: Method Parameter Rule: Methods requiring parameters must include parameter values from test data or hardcoded test values
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF method requires parameter THEN include parameter value in mapped_script WHERE parameter is either self.p.{property} for dynamic data OR quoted string for static test data

automation_scripts_rules.description: Exception Handling Rule: Methods that may raise exceptions must include raise_e parameter specification
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF method may raise exception that should be suppressed THEN include raise_e=False parameter AND document exception handling in action description

automation_scripts_rules.description: Screen Transition Verification Rule: Every screen transition must have corresponding verification step
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF action causes screen transition THEN next sub_step must verify new screen title using verify_*_screen_title() method AND verification confirms successful transition

automation_scripts_rules.description: Sequential Sub-Step Ordering Rule: Sub-steps must maintain strict sequential order matching execution flow
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: sub_step_id must follow pattern {step_number}{letter} WHERE step_number matches parent test_step number AND letter sequence (a,b,c...) represents execution order AND no gaps in sequence allowed

automation_scripts_rules.description: Action Description Clarity Rule: Each sub_step action must clearly describe what the automation does in business terms
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: action field must contain clear description of automation action in present tense AND avoid technical jargon AND focus on business intent AND be concise (under 100 characters)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Object Model Pattern Rule: Automation scripts must follow page object model pattern with self.{page_object}.{method}() structure
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: mapped_script must follow pattern self.{page_object}.{method_name}({parameters}) WHERE page_object represents UI screen/component AND method_name describes action AND parameters are optional

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Data Reference Rule: Dynamic test data must be referenced through self.p.{property} pattern
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test data varies per test execution THEN reference using self.p.{property} pattern WHERE p represents test properties object AND property name matches test data field

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Numbering Rule: Implicit steps use 'I' prefix for required execution steps and 'S' prefix for supporting validation steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF implicit step is required for execution THEN sub_step_id format is 'I{number}{letter}' ELSE IF implicit step is supporting validation THEN sub_step_id format is 'S{number}{letter}' WHERE number increments per implicit step group

automation_scripts_rules.description: Continue Button Reuse Rule: Same continue button method may be reused in different contexts with different semantic meanings
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF same UI element (e.g., Continue button) appears in multiple steps THEN same method (click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn) may be mapped to different test steps AND action description must clarify context-specific purpose

automation_scripts_rules.description: Email Form Field Rule: Email-related form fields must specify field purpose (To, Subject, Body) in method name
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test_step involves email form field THEN method name must include field identifier (receiver_email_id, subject, body) AND use enter_* pattern for input actions

automation_scripts_rules.description: Shortcut Configuration Rule: Shortcut creation flows must include destination selection, configuration, and final addition steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test involves shortcut creation THEN flow must include: toggle destination selection sub_step, continue to configuration sub_step, configure settings sub_steps, add to shortcut sub_step AND verify final shortcut settings screen

automation_scripts_rules.description: Printer Setup Rule: Printer-related tests must include device addition, search by IP, and device selection sub-steps
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF test requires printer setup THEN include sub_steps: click_add_device_btn(), search_printer_by_ip(ip_address), click_printer_device_card() in sequence AND IP address must be parameterized

automation_scripts_rules.description: Explicit vs Implicit Step Classification Rule: Classify steps based on presence in original manual test case
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF step appears in original manual test case THEN it is explicit step with numeric identifier ELSE IF step required for automation but not in manual test THEN it is implicit step with 'Implicit Step' prefix AND appropriate purpose classification

automation_scripts_rules.description: Verification Consolidation Rule: Multiple related verification steps may be consolidated into single supporting implicit step
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: IF multiple verify_* calls validate same test objective across different screens THEN consolidate into single implicit supporting step with multiple sub_steps AND prefix with purpose explanation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Case Mapping Completeness Rule: All test steps from manual test case must have corresponding automation mapping
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: EVERY numbered test step from manual test case MUST appear in correlation mapping AND may be supplemented with implicit steps AND final mapping must achieve complete test case coverage

automation_scripts_rules.description: Script Line Preservation Rule: Original script lines from correlation must be preserved exactly in intermediary breakdown
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: mapped_script in intermediary_steps sub_steps MUST exactly match corresponding portion of mapped_script_line from correlation AND no modification to method names, parameters, or syntax allowed

automation_scripts_rules.description: Future Automation Consistency Rule: All rules must be applied consistently across test cases to ensure standardized automation framework
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: ALL automation scripts MUST follow these rules consistently AND deviations must be documented with justification AND rules must be reviewed and updated based on framework evolution
